thesis.description: Contrast repeated manual prospecting work with a shorter Vision-assisted workflow.
thesis.psychologicalMechanism: Visible friction creates recognition; a concrete automated alternative creates contrast and relief.
thesis.whyItMayWork: The before/after operational contrast is easy to understand when the manual steps and product proof are both visible.
whenToUse: The manual workflow is common and visually understandable.
Vision can genuinely reduce or consolidate the steps.
whenNotToUse: The alleged manual pain is not real for the audience.
The product proof cannot be shown clearly.

hook.objective: Make the repetitive manual workflow immediately recognizable.
hook.formula: Show the repetitive manual process, then pivot quickly to the same objective completed through Vision.
originalExamples: Tu fais encore ça à la main pour trouver tes prospects ?

story.objective: Make the repetitive manual workflow immediately recognizable.
Show the repeated steps and friction.

visual.openingVisualIntent: Open on visible manual friction before revealing Vision.
visual.proofMoment: A concrete Vision output replacing several manual steps.
visualFailureModes: Generic AI-saves-time message with no proof.
Too much setup before the product appears.

forbiddenMoves: Claiming automation that Vision does not actually perform.

provenance.abstractionNotes: Initial Vision V1 seed defined during product specification.
